title: Add or remove a security operative subclass
summary: You can apply online to add or remove a class or subclass to your security operative licence if you meet the required qualifications, training, and experience.
intro:
If you hold a security operative licence, you can apply online to add another class or subclass if you have the required qualifications, training and experience.

You can also remove a class or subclass if you wish.

If your licence has been issued under mutual recognition you need to contact the Security Licensing & Enforcement Directorate (SLED) on 1300 362 001.
who_can_apply: Australian citizen or permanent Australian resident
Holder of a visa sponsored by a master licence holder
Holder of a visa for a skilled occupation corresponding to the proposed licence activities
what_you_need: Copies of acceptable training documents for Class 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D, or 1F licences, showing your name, date of issue, and units of competency.
Evidence of required training and experience for Class 2A, 2D, or 2E licences
The security operative licence number and details (check at Verify NSW)
All documents must show your name written and spelt in exactly the same way (unless you provide acceptable evidence of a change of name).

how_to_steps.text: Gather all the required details and documents.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to add or remove a security operative subclass.

faqs.q: What should I do if my licence was issued under mutual recognition?
faqs.a: You need to contact the Security Licensing & Enforcement Directorate (SLED) on 1300 362 001.

faqs.q: How do I check my security operative licence number and details?
What is required to add a subclass to my licence?
faqs.a: You must gather all required details and documents, log in or create a MyServiceNSW Account, and follow the prompts to add the subclass.
